page.overview:
What is Ap'lek's Mandalorian executioner vibro-ax?

Ap'lek's Mandalorian executioner vibro-ax was an antiquated Mandalorian executioner's vibro-ax that was the weapon of choice for the Knight of Ren Ap'lek. Ap'lek fought with the vibro-ax against Ben Solo on Exegol, but it availed him naught and he perished at the hands of his former leader.

A Mandalorian executioner's vibro-ax forged in ancient times, the weapon was equipped with ultrasonic transmission plates that enhanced its cutting power, turning the ax into a vibro-ax. It was also made of beskar, which resisted the blade of a lightsaber. There were gore channels carved into the face of the blade, as well as vibro-insulator plates to protect the handle of the ax from the vibrations.

The vibro weapon was used by Ap'lek, a member of the Knights of Ren, in conjunction with his smoke canister, incorporated so for his preference for stealth. The ax was once used long ago by a Mandalorian executioner.

In 35 ABY, Ap'lek used his ax to battle Ben Solo, former leader of the Knights of Ren, within the Sith Citadel on the planet Exegol. The ax was left on the battlefield as its wielder dropped it when he was Force pushed to his death.
